inputs.original_text: Introduced as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, the proposed legislation would require guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties for...
inputs.modified_text: New York’s 2026 State of the State agenda includes a proposal to dictate how guns sold in the state must be designed, supposedly to prevent them from being easily modified into illegal machine guns. It would also create criminal penalties, though the message I received cuts off before explaining what those penalties would cover. Preventing illegal weapons is a legitimate goal, but Albany should be clear about who would actually be punished—and avoid turning a measure aimed at criminals into another burden on lawful owners and manufacturers.
